name: DS Cluster D09: Economic Revisions (FRED Vintage Analysis)
description: Tests: economic_revisions for PAYEMS (NFP), revision_delta, revision_count outputs.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D09: Economic Revisions
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === NFP REVISIONS ===
rev = economic_revisions(series_id="PAYEMS")()
initial = ffill(rev.initial_value)
latest = ffill(rev.latest_value)
revision_delta = ffill(rev.revision_delta)
revision_count = ffill(rev.revision_count)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="NFP: Initial vs Latest Value",
    category="Revisions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Initial", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Latest", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(initial, latest))

xy_lines(
    title="NFP Revision Delta (Latest - Initial)",
    category="Revisions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Delta", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=revision_delta)
